import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    B = int(data[1])
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    cut = 0
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    money = []
    
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        
        if even == odd and even != 0:
            money.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))
    
    money.sort()
    
    for cost in money:
        if B >= cost:
            cut += 1
            B -= cost
    
    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
